description.p: Mari is a minimalist yet powerful app aimed at one thing: making the best text possible.

Write your draft. Read it back and mark it up — good, weak, cut, come back to this. Then rewrite the weak parts with the original open beside them, so you can see what you are changing. Anything you cut goes to the drawer instead of nowhere, and comes back whenever you want it.

All of it is kept in one file. The text, the marks, your notes, the old versions, the plan and a map of the whole piece live in a single .mari file. Send that file to somebody and they open exactly what you see.
